name: WL-5
summary: One of Ichiro Kato's WL (Waseda Leg) series, the hydraulically actuated lower-limb mechanism that achieved a slow but complete static walking cycle in three dimensions. WL-5 provided the legs that were combined with arms, vision and speech to make WABOT-1 the following year.

sources.title: Waseda Humanoid Robotics Institute — history of the WL and WABOT series
